title: US stocks: US market starts the month strong as Mideast deal hopes rise
description: Major US stock indexes opened higher on Monday. De-escalating Middle East tensions helped drag down crude oil prices. Investors are now preparing for a busy week of earnings reports. The Dow Jones Industrial Average increased by 274 points at the open. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite also saw gains.

title: Closing auction session for equity cash segment comes into effect
description: India's stock markets have introduced an innovative auction system to determine closing prices, specifically designed for cash market stocks paired with derivative contracts. This progressive framework is set to enhance transparency and effectiveness in price discovery, aligning India with international standards. Consequently, it will influence the settlement prices for both stock and index derivatives, marking a significant evolution in trading practices.

title: DLF Q1 Results: Profit rises 4% to Rs 794 crore; revenue declines 46%
description: DLF Ltd has recorded a modest profit growth of four percent in the June quarter, though total income suffered a notable drop, affecting its financial outcomes. The increase in net profit stems from better performance in associate and joint ventures. However, a significant downturn in sales bookings occurred due to postponed housing project launches.

title: RBI sells USD 14.9 bn during Jan-May to check excess volatility in rupee
description: In an effort to stabilize the rupee, the Reserve Bank of India sold USD 14.9 billion. Banks are also re-engaging with defaulters to recover substantial written-off loans. The SWAMIH Fund has been effective in funding 147 projects, benefitting many home buyers. Interestingly, defaults on gold loans have plummeted for both banks and NBFCs. Moreover, Kisan Credit Card accounts now reflect over Rs 10 lakh crore in outstanding credit.

title: Divi's Laboratories among 7 stocks to hit 52-week highs and surge up to 25% in a month

Divi's Laboratories, TVS Motor, Bajaj Auto and Bajaj Finance led the rally, reflecting strong buying momentum and improving investor sentiment across key sectors.

title: Market wrap: TCS, IndiGo, Sun Pharma among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Monday
description: Indian benchmark indices surged on Monday after easing crude oil prices, sparked by renewed US-Iran talks, boosted investor sentiment. The Sensex jumped 544 points and the Nifty climbed 1.6%, adding nearly Rs 5 lakh crore to BSE market capitalisation. TCS, IndiGo and Infosys led gains, while Sun Pharma and Apollo Hospitals lagged.

title: Bitcoin trades near $63,000 as falling oil prices ease inflation worries; weak flows limit recovery
description: Bitcoin traded near $63,000 as easing oil prices reduced inflation concerns, but weak institutional inflows and subdued spot activity capped gains. Ethereum and major altcoins declined, while analysts cited cautious investor sentiment, tighter liquidity and continued market consolidation.
